Highly Recommended Physiotherapy Clinic in Phuket!
I had a great experience at Great Physiotherapy Clinic Phuket. The booking and communication were excellent and very smooth. The therapists are friendly, polite, and professional. They clearly explained what they would do during the treatment, which really helped me.
It was my first time trying shockwave therapy and PMS, so I felt a bit nervous at the beginning. However, the therapist made me feel very comfortable and relaxed throughout the session.
I’ve been to another physiotherapy clinic in Phuket before, but this one is much better in terms of service and the price is more reasonable too. I will definitely come back and highly recommend this clinic to anyone needing physiotherapy in Phuket.
The only small issue is parking, as it’s located in a small soi. I parked on the road near We Cafe without any problem, but if that area is full, you may need to park at BKK Phuket Hospital nearby.

I came to this clinic with injured ankle. I can’t walk, stand and I barely moved my foot that time. I’m so happy that I found this clinic. Here I found highest quality treatments and professional, friendly physiotherapists. I visited thirteen times my physiotherapist and always everything was perfect. Now I can walk and back for normal life. Thank you so much and I wish you all the best ! 😉

This place is amazing. After breaking the top of me Femur this summer requiring a hip replacement I’ve had a lot of pain. Their knowledge and professionalism is amazing. After only a few treatments most of the pain is gone and I’m back to rebuilding my leg strength.

Best Physio in Phuket and honestly one of the best specialists I came across in my life. Very smart and detail oriented doctors. Nice atmosphere and people working here are with proper knowledge in what they practice.

Had some issues with my right knee from a reckless activity, since then, had some annoying pain there. I did go through many sessions here, and my knee has been in a better shape now. Thank you for taking care of my knee

received treatment for my office syndrome at this wonderful physiotherapy clinic in Phuket, and it was amazing. All the physiotherapists were kind, gentle, and highly skilled. The treatment was very effective, and I felt so much better afterward. Highly recommend this clinic!

Came in to treat my lower back. My physician was very professional and knowledgeable. Felt a lot of relief after the treatment.

Appointment was very easy to make and they were very responsive. And the price of treatment was only 1000 baht, which is a lot cheaper than some places that markets to tourists and foreigners.

Overall, amazing experience.

Best physio experience I’ve had! I saw Bu after injuring myself in Muay Thai training 2 days before a fight. She was very knowledgable and used a variety of different machines and methods to work on my injury. The session is 1000 baht for 90 minutes and you definitely get every bit of value for your money. I will come back again once or twice before I leave.

The best physiotherapy in Phuket!
All the physiotherapists are very nice and professional. They explain everything clearly and make it easy to understand.

Highly recommended!

I recently visited a physiotherapist for my lower back pain, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The treatment was highly effective, providing significant relief from the discomfort I had been experiencing. The therapist used a variety of techniques that truly worked. They were professional, knowledgeable, and attentive to my needs. I highly recommend their services to anyone seeking relief from pain or injury.

I have been having physio sessions twice a week for the last six weeks since my Achilles tendon rupture.  I cannot fault this CLINIC in anyway.   90 minutes of full on treatments all sorts of treatments for whatever injuries you have.   800 is a great price per session at CLINIC.

Would definitely recommend this place. I went there without an appointment and was helped right away. They have a very good knowledge and materials to help you. I went there with a lot of pain in my back, the next day I could really feel the difference.
I had a sore neck from a long trip to Thailand and the team at Great clinic took the pain away they are knowledgeable  and friendly will recommend to anyone
I highly recommend this place! full professionalism and nice service 😊 …
Great treat from staff, good equipment, local price. Excellent service overall.
Therapists are experienced and skilled. And great service.
Great service!
Thank you so much for treating my injuries for the last couple of months!
Very professional for a local price 👍🏾💯 …

I went to Great Physical Therapy Clinic and was very impressed.
The place is clean, the equipment is complete, and the atmosphere is comfortable, making me feel relaxed from the moment I walked in.
Dr. Sai provided excellent care, paying attention to detail. She explained my symptoms and treatment methods in an easy-to-understand way, wasn't rushed, and constantly checked on my condition, making me feel more confident and comfortable.
After the treatment, I felt a clear improvement. I highly recommend this place to anyone with aches, pains, or injuries. 👍

I have a herniated disc in my neck and spinal stenosis.
I was sick with a sore throat, headache, back pain, severe shoulder stiffness, and cramps… it was very difficult for me.
But since going to this clinic and receiving treatment, my symptoms have improved significantly. 😄😄😄
I am very grateful to the doctor. 🙏🙏

The doctor and all the staff at this clinic provide excellent service. It's fantastic! 😆😆
I highly recommend it.

I've been with them for 7 sessions. I have back and knee pain.

I'm not really sure if they fixed the pain, but I really enjoyed my time there. I felt they were caring, the place was clean, quiet, and friendly. I felt they gave hope from the way they treated me with their fingers and machines.

The price for both back and knee treatment was 1,000 baht. Thank you for having me and for your care. I did some research and found this physiotherapy clinic, so I decided to try it. I have a slipped disc and mild osteoarthritis in my knee. As soon as I entered the clinic, I gave the staff a report about my knee and the disc in which vertebra. They took me in right away, changed my clothes, and immediately started the treatment. It was about seven sessions over two weeks. They used electrical stimulation, sound waves, and many other things. I don't know if I improved, but I appreciated their treatment and how concerned they were about me. From what I understand, the treatment used to be cheaper; a session was 800 baht, and now it's 1000 baht (equivalent to 100 riyals). But it's worth 100 riyals for the attention, the therapeutic massage, and the electrical devices for muscle strengthening.

Thank you to Dr. Great and the other doctors for the excellent service. All the doctors are lovely.

A friend recommended this place, and I wasn't disappointed at all. It's the best physiotherapy clinic in Phuket. If you have aches and pains from office syndrome or muscle inflammation from exercise, I highly recommend it. You'll see results from the very first session. It's totally worth it!
The service was good and the place was clean. The physiotherapist was skilled and explained every step of the therapy. My back pain improved significantly after just two sessions.
Very good!!!
I had a spinal nerve compression problem and my symptoms improved significantly after physical therapy, along with taking medication. The staff were exceptionally attentive.
Dr. Bam is knowledgeable and skilled, and the service is lovely. The clinic is clean and smells of herbs, like a massage parlor.
Excellent service, very impressed. The problem was addressed effectively. I highly recommend the anti-inflammatory seat cushion. 🙏🙏🙏🙏 …

Dr. Great and the team are lovely. They gave great advice and provided excellent care.
I highly recommend them; you won't be disappointed. It's totally worth it!
